description: Generate a color palette while preserving specific locked colors. Uses deterministic perceptual search in OKLCH/HCT/LAB/HSL and avoids universally disliked colors.

colorSpace.description: Color space for palette generation/interpolation (oklch/hct/lab are perceptually uniform)

lockedColors.description: Colors that must be included in the palette

mode.description: Generation mode: harmony (cohesive), contrast (distinct), or gradient (smooth transition)

totalColors.description: Total number of colors in the final palette

name: generate_palette_with_locks
